title: I-Avatar Medical ne-Kyber zithole uxhaso lwezigidi ezingu-€3,7 lokwandisa ukufinyelela ezithombeni ze-3D ezibhedlela
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Ukusebenzisana nezithombe zezokwelapha ngesikhathi sangempela kungenye yezinkinga zokubambezeleka ezinzima kakhulu ezikhona.” kusho uJean-Baptiste Kempf, i-CEO ye-Kyber. “Ukubambezeleka obekungeke kubonakale nhlobo ocingweni lwevidiyo kuphihliza isithombe sonke uma iso ngalinye lithola umbono walo. Ukuxazulula le nkinga yikho okwenza konke okunye kube nokwenzeka. Ngokuhlanganisa ukubonisa okucwilisayo kwe-Avatar Medical nengqalasizinda ye-Kyber yokusakaza ngesikhathi sangempela, i-MediVerse yakhelwe ukwenza lokho kusebenzisana kuhambe kahle ngaphandle kwezithiyo kuzo zonke izindawo namadivayisi. Kuyisibonelo esiqinile sendlela ubuchwepheshe obujulile obusungulwa eFrance obungabhekana ngayo nenselelo ebalulekile nengokoqobo emkhakheni wezempilo.
html:
I-Avatar Medical ne-Kyber zimemezele namuhla ukuthi zithole uxhaso olufinyelela ezigidini ezingu-€3,7 ngohlelo lukahulumeni waseFrance i-France 2030. Lolu xhaso luzosetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa i-Avatar MediVerse, iphrojekthi ehlose ukuthi odokotela neziguli bakwazi ukubuka ukwakheka komzimba wesiguli ngasinye ngezithombe ze-3D ezibukeka njengezangempela, noma kuphi lapho bezidinga khona.

Njengamanje, ukuze isiguli noma udokotela abone ukwakheka komzimba nge-3D yangempela ngaphandle kwezibuko ezikhethekile, kudingeka amakhompyutha anamandla eduze kwesikrini. Lokho kungasho ukuthi lezi zithombe zitholakala kuphela emakamelweni ahlonyiselwe lo msebenzi. I-MediVerse yakhelwe ukuba icubungule izithombe kwenye indawo bese izisakaza bukhoma esikrinini. Lapho ebonana nesiguli, udokotela ohlinzayo angasikhombisa isimila ahlela ukusisusa, aphinde abuke ukwakheka komzimba waleso siguli lapho ehlela ukuhlinza, abuye akubuke nasegumbini lokuhlinzela.

I-Avatar MediVerse ihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obubili baseFrance obuphelelisanayo. I-Avatar Medical iletha isofthiwe yayo, i-Avatar Medical Vision, evunyelwe yisiphathimandla saseMelika esilawula ukudla nemithi futhi enophawu lwaseYurophu lokuhambisana nezimfuneko. Iguqula izithombe ezivamile ezithathwe ngemisebe ye-X noma ngozibuthe zibe izithombe ze-3D ezibukeka njengezangempela, umsebenzisi angazinyakazisa noma aziphendule. Akudingeki ukuba umuntu azihlukanisele izingxenye zesithombe. Inkampani iphinde ilethe ulwazi eluthole ngokusebenza nezibhedlela ezingaphezu kuka-20 e-United States naseYurophu. I-Kyber inikeza ingqalasizinda eyakha izithombe ze-3D endaweni ekude bese izisakaza bukhoma ngokulibaziseka okuncane kakhulu.

Ukusakaza izithombe ezinokujula kwangempela akufani nokusakaza ividiyo evamile eyisicaba. Iso ngalinye kudingeka lithole isithombe salo bukhoma, futhi izithombe kufanele zishintshe ngokushesha lapho udokotela ezinyakazisa noma eziphendula ukuze abone kangcono.

“Ukusebenzisa izithombe zezokwelapha eziphendula ngaso leso sikhathi kungenye yezinselelo ezinzima kakhulu uma kuziwa ekunciphiseni ukubambezeleka,” kusho uJean-Baptiste Kempf, i-CEO ye-Kyber. “Ukubambezeleka obungeke ukubone nakancane engxoxweni yevidiyo kusona sonke isithombe lapho iso ngalinye lithola esalo. Uma sesiyixazulule le nkinga, konke okunye kuyenzeka. I-MediVerse ihlanganisa izithombe ze-3D ezibukeka njengezangempela ze-Avatar Medical nengqalasizinda ye-Kyber yokusakaza bukhoma, ukuze kube lula ukusebenzisa lezi zithombe ezindaweni ezahlukene nangemishini ehlukene. Lesi yisibonelo esihle sendlela ubuchwepheshe obuphambili obusungulwa eFrance obungaxazulula ngayo inkinga yangempela nebalulekile kwezempilo.”

Ku-Avatar Medical, i-MediVerse iyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekufezeni umbono wayo obanzi wokusebenzisa izithombe ukuze kuqondwe kangcono okubalulekile lapho kuhlinzwa. Inhloso ukuthi ulwazi olusezithombeni zesiguli ngasinye lutholakale kuzo zonke izigaba zokunakekelwa kwaso, kunokuba izithombe ezisezingeni eliphezulu zigcine ekhompyutheni eyodwa noma egumbini elilodwa. Ngokuthi izithombe zicutshungulwe kwenye indawo, i-MediVerse ingenza kube lula ukwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe ze-3D ezinyakaziswayo ezibhedlela, ezinhlelweni zezempilo nasezikhungweni zokunakekela ezisabalele ezindaweni ezahlukene.

“Sikhethe ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili obukhona bokucubungula nokusakaza bukhoma. Kuvele ukuthi bungobaseFrance,” kusho u-Elodie Litzler, iphini le-CEO nomunye wabasunguli be-Avatar Medical. “Ayikho kulezi zinkampani ezimbili ebingakwenza lokhu yodwa. Asifuni nje ukufaka imishini emisha ezibhedlela. Sifuna ukushintsha indlela iziguli nodokotela abakuqonda ngayo abakubonayo, nokuthi bangakwenza kuphi lokho.”

Le phrojekthi yakhelwe kubuchwepheshe obunekhodi evulekile. Ihlose nokwenza izibhedlela zikwazi ukulawula kangcono ingqalasizinda yazo, zinganciki kakhulu ezinkundleni zezinkampani ezinekhodi evaliwe zokubuka izithombe ukude.

Uxhaso lukhishwe ngaphansi kwesimemo se-France 2030 sokufaka iziphakamiso zamaphrojekthi ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi “Ubuchwepheshe obusha bemihlaba yedijithali ezwakala njengeyangempela”. Ikomidi elizimele lochwepheshe lihlole iziphakamiso, kanti i-Bpifrance yengamele ukuqaliswa kwephrojekthi egameni likahulumeni waseFrance.

Mayelana ne-Kyber

I-Kyber yinkampani yaseFrance yobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Yakha ingqalasizinda esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela emkhakheni wezempilo, kwezamarobhothi, ekwakheni izithombe ngamakhompyutha akude nasezinhlelweni zevidiyo ezisebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa. Funda kabanzi ku-https://kyber.tech .

Mayelana ne-Avatar Medical

I-Avatar Medical yasungulwa ngo-2020 futhi ihamba phambili ekusebenziseni izithombe ukuze kuqondwe kangcono okubalulekile lapho kuhlinzwa. Yakha uhlelo olungasetshenziswa kabanzi, oluguqula izithombe zezokwelapha zibe ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ekunakekeleni isiguli kuzo zonke izigaba zokuhlinzwa. Umkhiqizo wayo oyinhloko, i-Avatar Medical Vision, uguqula ngokuphazima kweso izithombe ezithathwe ngemisebe ye-X noma ngozibuthe zibe izithombe ze-3D ezibukeka njengezangempela futhi ezinganyakaziswa noma ziphendulwe, ngaphandle kokudinga ukuhlukanisa izingxenye zesithombe. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ngodokotela ukuqonda ukwakheka komzimba wesiguli ngasinye, ukuhlela ukuhlinza, ukusebenzisana nokuxoxa neziguli. Kusukela ekubonisaneni nesiguli nasekuhleleni ukuhlinza kuze kufike egumbini lokuhlinzela, inkampani isebenzela ukwenza lolu lwazi lutholakale noma kuphi lapho kwenziwa khona izinqumo ezibalulekile ngokuhlinza. I-Avatar Medical yakhula ocwaningweni olwenziwa e-Institut Curie nase-Institut Pasteur. Inemikhiqizo yobuchwepheshe evunyelwe yisiphathimandla saseMelika esilawula ukudla nemithi futhi enophawu lwaseYurophu lokuhambisana nezimfuneko. Isebenza nezibhedlela ezingaphezu kuka-20 e-United States naseYurophu. Funda kabanzi ku-avatarmedical.ai .
